notes: Identity assessment: substantive primary research-report parse with Methods, Results, Discussion, tables and references, rather than an abstract or preregistration. Unassigned sides/fields are placeholders only. Candidate evidence: χ2 (1, N = 535) = 1.17, p = .280 ... χ2 (1, N = 535) = 0.99, p = .320 ... χ2 (1, N = 265) = 0.00, p = .951 ... Printed McNemar OR retained only as a candidate odds ratio, not converted to chi-square or selected as requested test statistic. No N sum or effect conversion.
